meta.name: Borealis
meta.author: dustycompiler
meta.cadence: GitHub Actions snapshot (not a guaranteed 15-minute tick; cron can drift or pause). STALE banner if snapshot age > 2 hours. On-page LIVE pulse: browser JSON-RPC to public Solana RPC (publicnode, mainnet-beta fallback) for slot/epoch/TPS at most every 60s. Snapshot values shown as NOT LIVE if RPC fails. Never invented.

live_pulse.label: LIVE / on-page-now vs snapshot generated_at
live_pulse.fail: NOT LIVE — last snapshot values; never invented
live_pulse.note: Browser JSON-RPC. publicnode first because api.mainnet-beta.solana.com 403s GitHub Pages Origin; publicnode CORS *. Same two keyless endpoints as generate.py. At most every 60s. Not a GitHub Actions tick.

dex.change_7d_meaning: percent change of 24h DEX volume vs the 24h from 7 days ago (not 7d-total vs prior 7d)

rwa.source: defillama.protocols chainTvls.Solana where category in {RWA, RWA Lending}

active_addresses.note: solana.com/data publishes several vendor series for the same label. Values disagree; Borealis does not average them.

sampled.priority_note: priority est. = meta.fee − 5000×n_signatures (base fee 5000 lamports/sig). Sampled, NOT a 24h census.
sampled.source: Solana RPC getBlock meta.fee (finalized, time-stratified sample)
sampled.sampled_runrate_note: sum(meta.fee) 0.0262 SOL over 9966s × 86400. ESTIMATED 24h in-protocol fees from the stratified sample, not a ledger.
sampled.note: NOT a 24h census. Time-stratified getBlock sample: 2 adjacent tip blocks (spot) + 11 slots spread over a ~2.8h window (target 10800s; ≤160 txs/slot subsampled). n_tx=2080 all-tx, n_nonvote=884, window_seconds=9966. p50 is all-tx meta.fee; non-vote p50 is separate. Do not read n=2080 as a 24h ledger — wall-clock window is 9966s.

economics.median_tx_fee_note: NOT a 24h census. Time-stratified getBlock sample: 2 adjacent tip blocks (spot) + 11 slots spread over a ~2.8h window (target 10800s; ≤160 txs/slot subsampled). n_tx=2080 all-tx, n_nonvote=884, window_seconds=9966. p50 is all-tx meta.fee; non-vote p50 is separate. Do not read n=2080 as a 24h ledger — wall-clock window is 9966s.
economics.priority_note: priority est. = meta.fee − 5000×n_signatures (base fee 5000 lamports/sig). Sampled, NOT a 24h census.

jito.tips_24h_note: INVALID 24h run-rate = landed tip-floor p50 (0.00000900 SOL) × non-vote TPS (1733) × 86400. tip_floor is a per-bundle landed percentile, not paid by every non-vote tx, and is not a 24h Jito tape. Not included in headline REV. Not added from DeFiLlama.
jito.sensitivity: sensitivity (NOT a 24h aggregate, NOT headline REV): invalid run-rate at p50 floor → 139549 USD; at p95 floor → 1488772 USD.
jito.sensitivity_note: sensitivity (NOT a 24h aggregate, NOT headline REV): invalid run-rate at p50 floor → 139549 USD; at p95 floor → 1488772 USD.

jito_runrate_not_rev.note: INVALID 24h run-rate = landed tip-floor p50 (0.00000900 SOL) × non-vote TPS (1733) × 86400. tip_floor is a per-bundle landed percentile, not paid by every non-vote tx, and is not a 24h Jito tape. Not included in headline REV. Not added from DeFiLlama.
jito_runrate_not_rev.label: INVALID as a 24h aggregate — tip_floor is per-bundle landed percentile, not paid by every non-vote tx

economics.rev_definition: Full network REV (Blockworks/Helius) is in-protocol transaction fees (vote + base + priority) plus out-of-protocol Jito MEV tips. Jito tape: GET kobe.mainnet.jito.network/api/v1/daily_mev_rewards (no key). Gross tips = jito_tips + validator_tips (Jito-paid/retained vs validator-distributed; not inclusive; split is not a TipRouter fee rate). UTC calendar day, aligned to solana.com/data Fees date. REV USD uses that same day's solana.com/data SOL Price, not the live snapshot. Never mix dates. tip_floor × TPS is NOT REV. DeFiLlama protocol/application fees are NOT REV.
economics.rev_kind: MEASURED UTC calendar day 2026-08-27: in-protocol fees + gross Jito MEV tips (jito_tips + validator_tips; not a rolling 24h); USD uses solana.com/data SOL Price (DexPaprika) UTC 2026-08-27
economics.rev_sensitivity: sensitivity (NOT a 24h aggregate, NOT headline REV): invalid run-rate at p50 floor → 139549 USD; at p95 floor → 1488772 USD.

rev_components.label: Jito tip-floor run-rate (NOT REV)
rev_components.source: INVALID 24h run-rate = landed tip-floor p50 (0.00000900 SOL) × non-vote TPS (1733) × 86400. tip_floor is a per-bundle landed percentile, not paid by every non-vote tx, and is not a 24h Jito tape. Not included in headline REV. Not added from DeFiLlama.

rev_routes_tried.route: getBlock stratified sample run-rate (sum meta.fee / window_seconds × 86400)
rev_routes_tried.role: ESTIMATED in-protocol cross-check, not added (would double-count solana.com Fees)
INVALID as a 24h aggregate — sensitivity only, not headline REV
INVALID sensitivity only, not summed into REV
EXCLUDED — application/protocol fees, not network REV
MEASURED Jito gross MEV tips UTC day (jito_tips+validator_tips)

economics.total_rev_note: Full network REV (Blockworks/Helius) is in-protocol transaction fees (vote + base + priority) plus out-of-protocol Jito MEV tips. Jito tape: GET kobe.mainnet.jito.network/api/v1/daily_mev_rewards (no key). Gross tips = jito_tips + validator_tips (Jito-paid/retained vs validator-distributed; not inclusive; split is not a TipRouter fee rate). UTC calendar day, aligned to solana.com/data Fees date. REV USD uses that same day's solana.com/data SOL Price, not the live snapshot. Never mix dates. tip_floor × TPS is NOT REV. DeFiLlama protocol/application fees are NOT REV. This run: MEASURED UTC calendar day 2026-08-27: in-protocol fees + gross Jito MEV tips (jito_tips + validator_tips; not a rolling 24h); USD uses solana.com/data SOL Price (DexPaprika) UTC 2026-08-27. Protocol fees 15447745.43 USD are listed separately and excluded.
economics.rev_spot_note: spot equivalent at this run SOL-USD; not the headline REV USD

jito_daily.accounting: gross_mev_tips_sol = jito_tips + validator_tips (jito_tips = Jito-paid/retained; validator_tips = validator-distributed; separate components, not inclusive; split is not a TipRouter protocol-fee rate)

parts.detail: mean slot 317 ms vs 400 ms target (400→30, 800→0)
TPS 3,893 vs solana.com/data Transaction Count (Total)|Allium / 86400 3,586 (ratio capped at 1.0)

"It's such a collaborative environment. It's so cool to be friends with someone, then six months later they start a company, then six months later they're absolutely crushing it and they're everywhere."

gates.method: getAccountInfo Feature accounts (encoding=base64). effective_epoch = epoch(activated_slot) + 1. Observed mean slot is corroboration only — never gate proof.
gates.changelog_quote: Feature gates reduced mainnet slot times from 400ms to 350ms, while Testnet moved from 250ms to 200ms.
gates.disclaimer: Do not treat observed ~367 ms as proof the 350 ms gate is live. Do not copy solana.com/upgrades/reduced-slot-times if it lists 400 ms as current.

editorial.summary: First-party Solana Changelog: August 20, 2026: “Feature gates reduced mainnet slot times from 400ms to 350ms, while Testnet moved from 250ms to 200ms.” On-chain Feature accounts: 400ms=superseded, 350ms=live, 300ms=live, 250ms=pending, 200ms=pending. Observed mean slot ~317 ms is corroboration only — not feature-gate proof. Alpenglow (SIMD-0326) remains the consensus rewrite (Votor / Rotor); it is a separate track from the slot-time feature gates.

simds.name: Markers for Alpenglow Fast Leader Handover
BLS Pubkey Management in Vote Account

timeline_public.item: Solana Changelog: August 20, 2026: “Feature gates reduced mainnet slot times from 400ms to 350ms, while Testnet moved from 250ms to 200ms.”
solana.com/news “Lowering Slot Time and Validators Economic” remains a listing-token write-up for SIMD-525 (SIMD-0525).
SIMD-0525 created (Anza). Four feature gates: 350/300/250/200 ms.
Observed mean slot ~317 ms is corroboration only — not feature-gate proof. INFERRED corroboration, not a feature-gate RPC.
SIMD-0387 (BLS pubkey in vote account) activated on mainnet.
SIMD-0357 VAT activated. VAT does not itself turn on Alpenglow consensus.

watch: Whether the 300 ms gate (effective epoch 1024 when activated at epoch-1023 start) is live once that epoch starts.
Skip rate / skipped slots as later 50 ms steps (250/200) get Feature accounts on mainnet.
Do not treat observed slot ms as activation proof.
Firedancer / Frankendancer Votor parity before a full Alpenswitch.
editorial.disclaimer: Editorial. Gate labels come from getAccountInfo Feature accounts (effective epoch = activation epoch + 1). Observed slot ms is INFERRED corroboration, not proof. Ignore solana.com/upgrades/reduced-slot-times if it lists 400 ms as current.
